Card Q&A.q: If [Marcus Damon] is treated as a Digimon by this card's effect and then its DP is reduced to 0 by an effect, is it deleted?

Effect: [On Play] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your [Marcus Damon]s is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon, can't digivolve and gains ＜Blocker＞.
[All Turns] When this Tamer becomes suspended, 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. If you have a Digimon with [Agumon] or [Greymon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
